units.source_text: 在以前，三公主每逢源氏多日不来，总是怨他薄情。

en.t: In the past, whenever Genji failed to visit for many days, the Third Princess always resented him for being heartless.

units.source_text: 但现在认为这与自己犯了过失有关。

en.t: But now she felt that this was connected with the fault she herself had committed.

units.source_text: 她想：“如果被父亲得知，他将何等伤心！”

en.t: She thought, "If my father were to learn of this, how terribly grieved he would be!"

units.source_text: 便觉人言可畏。

en.t: She therefore felt how frightening people's gossip could be.

units.source_text: 那柏木还是不断地写信来诉苦。

en.t: Kashiwagi, meanwhile, still kept sending letters in which he poured out his misery.

units.source_text: 小侍从不胜烦恼忧惧，就把信件泄露之事告诉了他。

en.t: Unable to bear her distress and fear, Kojiju told him that the letters had been exposed.

units.source_text: 柏木大吃一惊，想道：“这件事是哪一天发生的呢？

en.t: Kashiwagi was deeply shocked and thought, "On what day did this happen?

units.source_text: 我一向担忧：日久以后，此事会不会自然而然地泄露出去？

en.t: I have always worried whether, as time passed, this affair might somehow come out on its own.

units.source_text: 因此非常谨慎小心，似觉天空中都有眼睛向我注视。

en.t: That is why I was so extremely cautious, as if even the sky had eyes watching me.

units.source_text: 何况现在被他本人看到了真凭实据！”

en.t: And now, of all things, he himself has seen undeniable proof!"

units.source_text: 他觉得又羞耻，又抱歉，又痛心。

en.t: He felt ashamed, remorseful, and heartsick all at once.

units.source_text: 此时正值盛夏，朝夕也不凉爽，他却浑身发冷，一句话也说不出来。

en.t: It was the height of summer, when even mornings and evenings were not cool, yet his whole body went cold and he could not say a word.

units.source_text: 他想：“多年以来，不论国家大事或公余游宴，源氏大人总召我参与其列，并且待我比别人更加亲切。

en.t: He thought, "For many years, whether in affairs of state or in banquets during leisure hours, Lord Genji has always summoned me to take part and has treated me more warmly than others.

units.source_text: 我很感谢，又很孺慕。

en.t: I was deeply grateful to him and looked up to him with almost filial affection.

units.source_text: 如今他已恨我，视我为狂妄不法之人，叫我有何面目再见他呢！

en.t: Now he must hate me and see me as a reckless, lawless man; how could I have the face to meet him again?

units.source_text: 如果索性和他绝交，从此不再见他，则外人看了定然诧怪，他也明知我有意规避。

en.t: If I simply break with him and never see him again, outsiders will surely find it strange, and he too will know that I am deliberately avoiding him.

units.source_text: 叫我如何是好啊！”

en.t: What in the world am I to do?"

units.source_text: 他心中惶惑不安，身体也患病了，连日不去朝觐。

en.t: His heart was bewildered and uneasy, and his body too fell ill, so for days he did not go to court.

units.source_text: 虽非犯了重罪，但觉一生从此完蛋。

en.t: Although he had not committed a grave crime, he felt that his life was ruined from this point on.

units.source_text: “事情果然到了这地步！”

en.t: "So things really have come to this!"

units.source_text: 他只得自怨自恨。

en.t: He could only blame and despise himself.

units.source_text: 既而又想道：“算了吧！

en.t: After a while he thought again, "Enough of this!

units.source_text: 这三公主本来不是一个温良淑慎的女子。

en.t: The Third Princess was never truly a gentle, virtuous, and prudent woman.

units.source_text: 会被我从帘底窥见，早就是不应该的了。

en.t: For me to have been able to glimpse her from beneath the curtain was something that should never have happened in the first place.

units.source_text: 那时夕雾就说此人轻佻，果然不错。”

en.t: At the time, Yugiri said she was frivolous, and he was right after all."

units.source_text: 他赞同夕雾的话，大概是为了强欲斩断情丝，所以吹毛求疵吧？

en.t: Perhaps he agreed with Yugiri's words because he was desperately trying to sever his attachment and so looked for faults in her.

units.source_text: 但他又想：“尊贵虽说是好的，但像她那样过分大方，一味高傲，以致不识世务，又不用心选择品质优良的侍女，因而发生这种意外之事，为己为人，两皆不利，真正可叹！”

en.t: But then he thought, "Noble birth may be a fine thing, but when someone like her is overly open, blindly proud, ignorant of the world, and careless in choosing worthy attendants, such an accident occurs, bringing harm to herself and to others alike. It is truly lamentable!"

units.source_text: 他又可怜三公主，对她终于不能断念。

en.t: Yet he also pitied the Third Princess, and in the end he could not give up his feelings for her.
